subject: I Play Rocky
query: is i play rocky a true story
title: Is I Play Rocky a true story? How Stallone got Rocky made
answer: Yes. "I Play Rocky" is based on the true story of how a young, unknown Sylvester Stallone fought to get "Rocky" made in the 1970s and to star in it himself. Anthony Ippolito plays Stallone. Directed by Peter Farrelly, the film opened in limited release on Nov. 6, 2026, and expands nationwide on Nov. 20.
body:
Amazon MGM Studios says Stallone was "told 'no' at every turn" but held firm on playing the lead role. "Rocky" was released in 1976, nearly 50 years before this film. Peter Gamble wrote the script, and the movie premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival on Sept. 12, 2026.

The cast plays real people from the making of "Rocky": AnnaSophia Robb as Stallone's wife, Sasha Czack; Matt Dillon as his father, Frank Stallone Sr.; P.J. Byrne and Toby Kebbell as producers Irwin Winkler and Robert Chartoff; Jay Duplass as director John G. Avildsen; Stephan James as Carl Weathers; Kiki Seto as Talia Shire; Robert Morgan as Burgess Meredith; and Scot Teller as Burt Young. Rob Demery plays boxer Joe Frazier, and Tracy Letts also appears.

Farrelly won the Oscar for best picture for "Green Book." The film is distributed by Amazon MGM Studios.
in_the_news: "I Play Rocky" expands to theaters nationwide on Nov. 20, 2026, after a limited release on Nov. 6.
